counts_scope: 180 saved occurrences, not all native hits; 166 identifiers are not 166 verified unique works. Include-for-abstract is a review queue, not confirmed relevance.
search_quality_limitations: Only the first 10 records per successful query/provider were collected.
Provider rankings and query semantics differ; raw native total counts are not relevant-work counts.
The arXiv expressions do not encode an explicit conjunction for every concept; returned Q4/Q6 records are largely lexical false positives.
Spanish piso/positivo strings yield nontechnical homonyms; absence of a relevant first-page title does not establish absence of antecedents.
Crossref indexes figures and tables as components; component DOIs are not independent articles.
Different DOIs with matching titles are retained as unverified possible versions.
